question: Should OpenClaw expose MCP reload as a permanent operator HTTP API only, or should `mcp.server.reload` be a fully implemented and documented gateway RPC method as well?
rationale: The branch adds a new core operator surface, and the descriptor currently implies a broader gateway-method contract than the submitted HTTP-only implementation supplies.

options.title: Keep it HTTP-only
options.body: Remove the unsupported core method descriptor and authorize the route through an existing internal scope mechanism without advertising a callable gateway RPC method.

options.title: Support gateway RPC too
options.body: Add the matching RPC handler, protocol/client follow-through, documentation, and compatibility tests so the descriptor represents a real public gateway method.

recommendation.title: Keep it HTTP-only
recommendation.body: Remove the unsupported core method descriptor and authorize the route through an existing internal scope mechanism without advertising a callable gateway RPC method.
